topic: How does the hybrid SIW-waveguide feeding topology balance efficiency and compactness in V-band satellite antenna designs?
consensus_response: The hybrid SIW-waveguide feeding topology balances efficiency and compactness by optimizing substrate material selection, waveguide dimensions, and array scale. Increased array size leads to higher insertion loss, impacting radiation efficiency. Optimizing these factors mitigates losses, ensuring reliable signal transmission and maintaining system performance.
reference_context: V-band satellite antennas require high gain, efficiency, and compactness, with substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) technology offering a solution to minimize transmission line loss.
